channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Alien Apocalypse
item.description: An open-world sandbox survival game set after a devastating alien invasion. Scavenge for resources, craft, build defenses, and harness alien technology to fight back. Play solo or in co-op and reclaim what’s left of the planet.

item.title: CICADAMATA"
item.description: + follow the white rabbit + hop, skip, and jump to become one with joyeuse, until you are no longer you +

item.title: Detective Sherlock: Shadow Stalker
item.description: Every character remembers, watches, tests, and may deceive you like a living person. They have emotions, voices, expressions, and buried secrets. Break them with words or evidence — or realize too late that you were only a pawn in their game. A detective game built around truly lifelike NPCs.

item.title: FEAR OF FAITH
item.description: FEAR OF FAITH is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game where cloned soldiers raid cursed WWII bunkers. Choose your class, combine spells and drink BEER to keep your FEAR away, or face a fate worse than DEATH

item.title: Lazy Witch's Factory
item.description: Your debt comes due in 30 minutes. Twist the rules through demonic contracts and survive impossible production quotas in this chaotic factory-building roguelite.

item.title: Mall: Tidy Up Together
item.description: Shelve the products, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the mall. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

item.title: Minsgon Simulator
item.description: Hatch mysterious eggs and discover over 150 Minsgon species! Tame, raise and train wild creatures to make them evolve, then sell them in your shop and garden. Unlock the skill tree and rise to fame in the world of Minsgon!

item.title: Moo Who?
item.description: Can you sound like an animal well enough to survive? Moo Who is a multiplayer voice-mimicry party game where animal players hide among NPCs, and make animal sounds into their mic before hunters figure out who is fake.

item.title: Settler's Domain
item.description: Settler's Domain is a strategy game about building a new settlement in unknown lands. Grow your population, explore the map, and contend with other settlements while keeping your settlers alive.

item.title: The Last Disease Z
item.description: The Last Disease Z is a co-op survival experience where everything is against you. Abandoned cities, zombies and bandits, a struggle for resources and a place to live. Build, unite, and survive.

item.title: The Sorting Bureau
item.description: A cozy sorting game set in a quiet Tokyo workshop. Clients bring you boxes of clutter: buttons, coins, gears, stamps. Sort, match, and piece everything together with satisfying ASMR clicks. No timers. Mistakes cost nothing. Just the joy of tidying up.

item.title: VHOLUME
item.description: VHOLUME is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.

item.title: BroomSweeper
item.description: Minesweeper gone Rogue(like). Stock your cart with 150+ powerful items while avoiding impish Dust Bunnies. Dare yourself to climb all 16 floors of the ominous Tentateq Tower—but beware, 7 logic-twisting Hazardous Materials stand between you and janitorial glory. Can you keep your job until morning?

item.title: CARIMARA: Beneath the forlorn limbs
item.description: A mute little thing with borrowed magic. A house that murmurs back. Ask wrong, and you might wake something that remembers your name.

item.title: Cataclismo - The Old Kingdom
item.description: Reclaim a lost realm in a new strategic mode – conquer and defend multiple citadels, marshal supply lines to fuel your advance, and hold back escalating waves of horrors as the final reckoning stirs. Rebuild the Old Kingdom, turn by turn.

item.title: Ghost Watchers
item.description: Ghost Watchers is a co-op online horror game. You will explore and hunt ghosts in abandoned houses

item.title: Hello Kitty Island Adventure - City Town
item.description: A rainbow metropolis awaits! Collect, create, and customize in this cozy adventure. Run your own personalized Cafe, set up all-new shops with Sanrio friends, and unlock the power of dreams to uncover the City’s hidden wonders.

item.title: Klonoa Phantasy Reverie Series
item.description: KLONOA is a 3D side-scrolling action game series whose first title was released by Namco in 1997. Set in a unique universe populated by a range of original characters, the game follows the hero, Klonoa, as he sets off on a journey to save the world.

item.title: Longvinter
item.description: Fish, farm, craft, gather, cook, loot or steal from other players and build a campsite or a village with your friends in an open-world multiplayer sandbox game without rules!

item.title: Mad King Redemption
item.description: Mad King Redemption is a unique blend of a traditional beat'em'up game with strong roguelite progression, mixed in a pixelated graphic style in a 2.5D world. Relieve the king from his madness while beating up corrupted enemies, in a fresh way at every run!

item.title: Trombone Champ
item.description: Honk, blow, & toot your way through over 60 songs, collect all 50 unique Tromboner Cards, and uncover the mysteries of the Trombiverse. Do you have what it takes to become the true Trombone Champ?

item.title: Vacation Cafe Simulator
item.description: Cozy Italian Vacation Cafe 🏖️ No timers, No stress 😌 cook traditional dishes 🍝 upgrade and customize 🏠 just drink Prosecco 🥂 relax and grow your dream cafe ✨

item.title: Brigador Killers
item.description: Isometric insurgent simulator. Fight on foot and in vehicles, build and steal a private arsenal and bring the war home to the businessmen who started it all in this continuation of the Brigador saga.

item.title: Cozy Marbles
item.description: Engineer the marble run of your dreams. No need to get it perfect – just release your marbles and let the good times roll.

item.title: Deep Blue Sushi
item.description: Deep Blue Sushi is a casual 1–5 player co-op adventure where you explore the ocean, catch fresh fish, prepare sushi, serve customers, and grow your restaurant while uncovering the secrets of the mysterious Deep Blue.

item.title: Drive Me Broke
item.description: Survive 🏚️, Gain Reputation ✊, Earn Money 💸, Build Your Car 🛠️, Win Races 🏁, Become a Legend 👑

item.title: Feed the Scorchpot
item.description: A dice roguelike about feeding a dragon for twenty years. Roll ingredients, build your island, and fuse absurd recipes into combos that break the score wide open. Miss a meal and you're next on the menu.

item.title: How to Fish
item.description: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

item.title: Ironsand
item.description: Ironsand is a co-op titan-slaying FPS roguelite set on a desert planet where powerful builds and team synergy are everything

item.title: Isonzo
item.description: Ferocious Alpine warfare will test your tactical skills in this authentic WW1 FPS. Battle among the scenic peaks, rugged valleys and idyllic towns of northern Italy. The Great War on the Italian Front is brought to life and elevated to unexpected heights!

item.title: KOTAMON: My Sis Found A Super-Rare Card In Her Cereal Box, So I Became A Garbage Man To Find The Entire Collection And Earn $1,000,000
item.description: Clearing trash can feel even better when you not only make the world cleaner, but also find extra-rare cards that have suddenly increased in price! Rummage through garbage, fulfill the orders from the dump site owner, look for hidden treasures... and collect all the Kotámons!

item.title: Mexican Ninja
item.description: Become the Mexican Ninja and fight to take back Nuevo Tokyo, where Narcos and Yakuzas have fused into the ruthless Narkuzas. Master slick combos, unleash outrageous Mexican Jutsus and craft deadly builds in this fast, chaotic 2.5D roguelike beat ’em up.

item.title: Sensory Overload
item.description: A dropper game designed to overwhelm your senses. Twisting tunnels, psychedelic patterns, and breathing walls assault your sense of balance as the chaos escalates with every level.

item.title: Slayblade
item.description: Build your battle-top and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts, Merge their Powers, and Dominate opponents in this Chill Roguelite! Skate around a vibrant Y2K city, winning Cash and Upgrades on your way to the top. And if you Die in the game, you Die in real life.

item.title: Swarmdustry
item.description: Build a living factory and automate the Swarm. Harvest resources, construct mega factories, and grow a colony of specialized biomechanical bugs. Balance growth, efficiency, and creep spread before hostile robots squish you for trying to consume their world.

item.title: Theropods
item.description: Outsmart hungry dinosaurs and bloodthirsty barbarians in a wordless point-and-click adventure through a prehistoric world — with a sci-fi twist.

item.title: Universe Sandbox
item.description: Create & destroy on an unimaginable scale with a realistic physics-based space simulator. Explore the beauty of our universe and the fragility of our planet. Use science to bend the laws of gravity, collide planets, boil away oceans, fire epic space lasers, and customize your universe.
